_about: Map types for the investment analysis. Names exactly as aoe4world summaries spell mapName.
Only land maps are analysed for now. A map in no list is analysed as land and its rows are flagged unlisted_map, until map types can be managed in the UI (Andrei, 21 Nov 2026).
Source: aoe4world ranked 1v1 map stats labels (10 Nov 2026), plus Golden Pit, Marshland and Socotra as land and Four Lakes as hybrid (Andrei, 21 Nov 2026).
